name: Override: carry a stack to a Neutral Goal
description: Drives the bite onto the yellow stack at (23.5, -23.5), closes the claw on the Cup's rim and sets the stack on the Pin in the neutral left Goal. The lift rises once the robot has driven 3 in toward the Goal, not during the turn: the Pin stands loose in the Cup and tips out if the lift stops while the robot turns. The lift goes down 0.3 s after the robot starts backing away. The left Toggle is still yellow, so the stack scores for neither alliance.

steps.note: the bite onto the stack until the Cup meets the plate
close on the Cup's top rim
toward the Goal, the lift still down
the bite onto the Goal, lifting the stack over its Pin on the way
set the Cup's rim on the Goal's Pin
back away, then lower the lift
